plain_english_summary: This is gadget insurance that comes free with the Meridian Current Account Plus bank account, paid for through the GBP 18.00 monthly account fee. It covers your registered laptop and smartphone against theft, accidental damage and breakdown after the warranty ends, anywhere in the world, up to GBP 2,000 per gadget. You pay an excess of GBP 50 per laptop claim or GBP 75 per smartphone claim. Loss, cosmetic damage, theft of a gadget left unattended in public and theft not reported to police within 48 hours are not covered, and cover stops if you close or downgrade the account.
